title: Permissions Lifecycle & Audit Dashboard — visualizer prototype and review
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and iterate a unified 'Permissions Lifecycle' dashboard for the Redwood Console that lets admins visualize role-to-permission mappings, recent access changes, and audit trails. The screen should surface risk signals (orphaned roles, excessive privileges), enable targeted access reviews, and integrate with rollout controls so teams can quickly see how permission changes affect dashboards, cost views, and model rollout routes.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity prototype that demonstrates role -> permission matrix with collapsible workspace/org scopes
Audit timeline component showing recent grant/revoke events with filters (actor, date, resource)
Access review flow mock that triggers an in-console task and records decisions in audit log
Design tokens and responsive layouts for desktop + 1280px min width screens
Designer handoff package (Figma file + component spec) and a short demo to PM/Eng
decisions: Use a combined matrix + timeline layout rather than separate pages to reduce context switching
Color encoding: red / amber / green to highlight risk categories (excessive, deprecated, compliant)
Access review modal will support bulk actions but require explicit justification for auto-approves
Cost and rollout impacts will be shown as contextual badges in the matrix (not full cost analytics)
Audit events will show resource snapshots (pre/post) where available; redact PII by default
comments: 2026-02-28 — Aisha: Kickoff: scoped the MVP to org+workspace roles, audit timeline, and access review flow. Collected PM notes from Sofia on required filters (actor, role, resource).

2026-03-03 — Marcus: Shared mid-fi prototypes in Figma. Request from Eng to show example of KV-cache role use case where permissions affect model routing. Added placeholder component for 'runtime impact' badge.
2026-03-06 — PM Sofia Reyes: Suggested adding an 'auto-scan' schedule option for access reviews (weekly/monthly) and a link to cost breakdown per role to help prioritize reviews.

2026-03-08 — Security (Ivan Liu): Raised concern about showing user email in timeline by default; requested anonymized display with 'reveal' for auditors. Also flagged requirement for audit log immutability note.
2026-03-10 — Design critique: Team prefers matrix sorting by risk score and ability to pin critical roles. Action: add sorting controls and pin states.
2026-03-12 — Review summary: Updated prototype with changes above. Ready for PM/Eng review session on 2026-03-15. Need engineering estimates for timeline pagination and export endpoints.
user_testing_findings: 5/6 admins were able to locate 'orphaned roles' in <30s once risk filters were highlighted
Confusion observed around scope column (org vs workspace). Decision: add clear scope pill + tooltip
Participants liked seeing 'runtime impact' badges but wanted a quick link to full cost view
Bulk revoke flow felt risky; testers asked for a simulation mode before applying changes
